subject: Problem with adding labels to faceted geom_bar

messages.author: 4cb195f26c6557f1
messages.subject: Problem with adding labels to faceted geom_bar
parts:
Hello,

I have been unsuccessful to add labels to a facet graph. The problem is that each label repeats itself on every facet. Dennis has a relevant posting. However, I haven't been able to relate it to my situation..

Probably, it is easier to explain the situation using the attached plot. As you see in the graph each added annotation has been repeated 3 times, one for each facets. My objective was to add the annotation once. For instance 21141 to the gray bar in the CD4 facet, 21262 to the gray bar in the CD8 facet and finally 21702 to the DP facet.

I have posted the code on github for those of you who prefer.

git clone git://gist.github.com/2379297.git gist-2379297


Also here:

library(ggplot2)

library(reshape)

# my data

data = data.frame(positively.reg = c(60,720, 640), 

negatively.reg = c(140, 40, 0), 

unchanged = c(21702, 21141, 21262), 

population = c("DP", "CD4", "CD8"))


# melt the data

data.melted = melt(data, id = "population", measure = c("unchanged", "positively.reg", "negatively.reg"))


# value of labels

v1 = data[2, c("unchanged", "positively.reg", "negatively.reg")]

v2 = data[3, c("unchanged", "positively.reg", "negatively.reg")]

v3 = data[1, c("unchanged", "positively.reg", "negatively.reg")]


plab = data.frame(lab = as.character(c(v1,v2,v3)), x = 1:3, y= seq(1000,9000,1000)) 


# plot the faceted bar graphs

dev.off()

p = ggplot(data.melted) 

p + geom_bar(aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = variable), stat = "identity") + 

facet_grid( . ~ population, space = "free") +

scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray60", "darkred", "darkgreen")) + labs(x="", y="Count") + 

opts(axis.text.x = theme_blank(), axis.ticks = theme_blank(), axis.title.x = theme_blank(), legend.title = theme_blank(), strip.text.x = theme_text(size=12, face="bold")) +

geom_text(data = plab, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab), size = 3)

messages.author: ddc91303cb21ac62
messages.subject: Re: Problem with adding labels to faceted geom_bar
parts:
Hi Robert,

You are super close here. The problem is that your annotation data
frame doesn't the levels to plot by. Both your plotting data frame AND
your annotation data frame need to have factor levels that correspond
the levels that you are plotting. So for example in your plab data
frame ggplot2 has no way to tell which label should be plotted where.
Because your plotting data.frame is the same length as your annotation
data frame this is illustrated quite easily. If they are different
length then you have to fiddle a little bit.

## Add the variable and population column to the annotation data.frame
plab$variable <- data.melted$variable
plab$population <- data.melted$population

## Then plot the same and the labels are facetted like the rest of the data.

ggplot(data.melted) +

geom_bar(aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = variable), stat =
"identity") +
facet_grid( . ~ population, space = "free") +
scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray60", "darkred", "darkgreen")) +
labs(x="", y="Count") +
opts(axis.text.x = theme_blank(), axis.ticks = theme_blank(),
axis.title.x = theme_blank(), legend.title = theme_blank(),
strip.text.x = theme_text(size=12, face="bold")) +

geom_text(data = plab, aes(x = variable, y = y, label = lab), size = 3)


I also changed the x value in geom_text to variable so that the labels
are staggered according to bars. Someone will probably come along and
offer a much more thorough explanation but this is essentially your
problem.

I hope that helps.

Sam
